claim: Ours, in Gravesend: a facade tile with painted windows is laid as whole windows, so no corner, doorway or cut window slices one: each straight stretch between corners and openings carries whole windows with the plaster between taking the remainder, a stretch too short for one wears the facade's windowless twin, and a window one can look through is cut where a painted one stands. Before it, phasing facades from the world's 1,024 grid with corners cut back half a bay left 43 of 236 windowed walls ending inside a window.
evidence: projects/blood-city/level/facade_bays.py docstring (the 43 of 236 count and the method), 2026-11-25; built for the owner's ruling whole-painted-windows-on-facades
use: Lay each straight stretch of front with whole windows; where too short for one, wear the windowless twin; cut real windows at windows_on.
